purpose: one record rendered as a card.
structure: A header carrying the record's title and its status badge, the badge taking the same palette entry the roster's status column takes.
The body, one labelled field per configured column.
The label sits above its value on a narrow viewport.
A footer carrying the row actions.
variants: **Compact** — the footer collapses into the header.

props.name: columns
props.carries: which fields become labelled rows, in order
